name: How long does the ADU construction process usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does the ADU construction process usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ADU construction process typically spans 8 to 18 months, depending on the project's complexity and local permitting timelines. Design and permitting can take 3 to 9 months, influenced by plan revisions and city review backlogs. The actual construction phase generally lasts 5 to 9 months, affected by weather, material availability, and inspection schedules. A well-prepared design and efficient project management can help streamline these timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: The entire process, from design to completion, usually takes 8 to 18 months, with design and permitting being a significant part of that timeline.
